description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the Resources interface, managing a collection of Resource objects with methods for creation, retrieval, modification, serialization, and iteration.

classes.name: ImmutableResources
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Resources interface, encapsulating a map of ResourceKey and Resource, providing methods to manipulate and serialize resources.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableResources instance from an iterable of Resource objects, ensuring no duplicate Resource keys.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutableResources object from a JsonObject, parsing the contained resources.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieves a resource by its ResourceKey, returning an Optional<Resource>.

methods.name: setResource
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutableResources instance with the specified resource added or replaced.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutableResources instance with the specified resource removed.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of resources contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the collection of resources is empty.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the resources to a JsonObject according to a specified schema version and predicate.
